response.overview: If you're looking for a new film including only the top rated riders out there whom you always see on TV, read no longer! This new film shows you the most stylish and yet so under-rated riders out there who will be taking their spot soon. The double-disc set titled It's Whatever is the latest work produced by Austin-based company Under360 as a result of their sophomore effort. The 2 Disc set features a DVD for both wakeskating and wakeboarding, all while being jam-packed with intense footage of the best talent in Texas. The box set captures the riding of Mitch Bergsma, Tom Fooshee, Gabe Lucas, Evan Lykes, Bret Little and many more.
response.title: It's Whatever
